# Rugged Enclosure

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model of a rugged enclosure designed to safely house electronics or small tools. The box features a robust, ribbed outer shell for strength, a hinged lid, and secure snap-fit latches.

## Features
- **Hinged Lid:** Securely covers the enclosure.
- **Snap-fit Latches:** Keeps the enclosure tightly closed.
- **Parametric:** Easily modify dimensions to fit custom requirements.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
